gaps.sentence: ___ books you left on my desk were really useful.
gaps.explanation: 'The books you left…' — the clause identifies which books.

gaps.sentence: She has ___ excellent command of Japanese.
gaps.explanation: 'Have an excellent command of' — 'excellent' starts with a vowel sound.
'Inflation' as a general economic concept takes no article.

gaps.sentence: ___ young woman at reception speaks five languages.
gaps.explanation: 'The young woman at reception' — defined by the location phrase.

gaps.sentence: The company is looking for ___ accredited supplier of packaging.
gaps.explanation: 'Accredited' begins with a vowel sound — 'an accredited supplier'.
Plural general nouns and flu (illness name) take no article.

gaps.sentence: The thief was sent to ___ prison for three years.
gaps.explanation: 'Sent to prison' — the institution, no article; 'the prison' would mean the building.

gaps.sentence: She did her doctorate at ___ University of Oxford.
